title: TapHound Configuration
description: Editor-validation schema for .taphound/config.json. The Zod schema in src/domain/config.ts is the runtime contract; unknown fields are rejected.

packageName.description: Qualified Java package of the target app, e.g. com.example.app. Never guessed; TapHound fails closed on mismatch with the installed package.

activity.description: Launch Activity: relative with a leading dot (resolved against run.packageName) or fully qualified.

strategy.description: Idle stability strategy. hybrid: frame counters with structural fallback; layoutDiff: layout-tree comparison only; frameStats: frame counters only (no fallback); structural: layout tree only.

pollIntervalMs.description: Sleep between polls, not the poll duration.

stablePolls.description: Consecutive stable polls required to declare idle.

timeoutMs.description: Total wait budget per idle phase. Each poll's own duration is charged against this budget; slow UI dumps require a larger value.

backend.description: UI capture backend. auto is the runtime default; appium is explicit-only and fails closed when unavailable.

snapshotTimeoutMs.description: Per-capture timeout for one UI snapshot. A single uiautomator dump can exceed 5s on large trees.

cacheEnabled.description: false disables only the run-scoped observation cache; never changes locator rules or action behavior.

backend.description: Device runtime backend selection. auto and adb resolve to the adb backend today; mobile-mcp routes device work through the Mobile MCP server. The TAPHOUND_RUNTIME_BACKEND environment variable overrides this field per invocation.

artifactsDir.description: Verify report output directory. May point outside .taphound, but any path inside .taphound must stay under .taphound/build (enforced at runtime).
